story.title: Story 1: Project Artifact Association Without Process Ownership

result.planSummary: Updated the project-shell/process-surface read paths so current process artifact visibility and reviewability can come from current refs instead of legacy single-process ownership hints, while preserving existing produced-artifact/package review behavior. Added story-level server coverage for stripped shell summaries, referenced-artifact materials, and cross-process referenced review access.

changedFiles.reason: Derive process artifact role labels from artifact version provenance instead of legacy artifact ownership fields.
Union current refs with produced artifacts when building review targets so cross-process references work without regressing existing review/package flows.
Allow artifact review when the process currently references the artifact, while preserving existing produced-artifact review access.
Added coverage that project-shell artifact summaries strip legacy process ownership fields from API output.
Added coverage for referenced-artifact materials labeling and review availability from current refs.
Added coverage for reviewing an artifact referenced by a later process but produced by an earlier one.

findingsFixed: Replaced legacy ownership-dependent current-material role labeling with version-provenance-based labeling so real Convex artifact summaries no longer misclassify referenced artifacts.
Expanded review target and artifact review eligibility to include current process refs without regressing existing produced-artifact and package-snapshot review behavior.
Caught and fixed the package/integration regression introduced by an overly narrow current-ref-only reviewability rule before final verification.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand off to story verification, with particular attention on cross-process artifact reference flows in the shell, process materials, and review entry points.
